Mt Hood #3 · Detail view

Size by bin range

Set any start and end BIN, or the same number in both for a single bin. If ranges overlap, the lower one wins. Nothing changes until you confirm.

Size by tin number

Give tin numbers a size, e.g. Tin #1–20 Small, #21–25 Medium. Every tin not in a range is Standard 100 (the default). If ranges overlap, the later one in the list wins. Nothing changes until you confirm.

Tip: Shift-click bins, or turn on bulk select and drag a box. Quick select
Click bins in order to number them.
Watches bin Cards bin Cards bin (blue) Items bin Tin Bin numbers run 1–16 in row A, 17–32 in B, 33–48 in C, 49–64 in D (blocks 06–09). Click a bin to open it.
